info.title: Decision Engine
info.description:
Open-source payment gateway routing service by Juspay. Selects the optimal payment processor for each transaction in real-time using success-rate scoring, rule-based routing, and elimination logic.

## Authentication

This API supports two authentication methods:

1. **JWT Bearer Token** - For dashboard/user sessions
   - Header: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`
   - Obtain via `/auth/login` endpoint

2. **API Key** - For service-to-service/programmatic access
   - Header: `x-api-key: DE_<64_char_hex>`
   - Create via `/api-key/create` endpoint

Protected endpoints require one of these authentication methods.

post.description:
Core routing decision API. Given a payment context and a list of eligible gateways, returns the optimal gateway to route to.

The engine applies a sequence of filters (currency, card brand, auth type, EMI, etc.) then scores remaining gateways using success rate history, elimination status, and contract obligations.

**Authentication:** Requires either JWT Bearer token or API Key.

preferredConnectors.description: Ordered connector:mca_id preferences from the customer's profile-scoped history. The first entry is considered; health and eligibility checks still apply.

paymentMethodType.description: Connector-defined payment method type, e.g. CARD, UPI, WALLET, NETBANKING.

paymentMethod.description: Connector-defined payment method, e.g. CREDIT, DEBIT, GPAY.

cardType.description: e.g. CREDIT, DEBIT, PREPAID, UPI, NB.

enableMultiObjective.description: Per-request override for the multi-objective (cost-aware) post-step. true forces it on, false forces it off; omitted falls back to the merchant's multi_objective_routing_enabled feature flag.

routing_approach.description: Routing approach used. SR_SELECTION_MULTI_OBJECTIVE indicates the multi-objective post-step promoted a cheaper gateway over the SR head.

multi_objective_info.description: Populated when the multi-objective post-step ran (multi_objective_routing_enabled feature flag or enableMultiObjective request field, outside hedging). Null otherwise.

gateway_before_evaluation.description: Gateway the SR head selected before the multi-objective / debit-routing post-step replaced it.

status.description: Transaction status. Must be a TxnStatus value - lowercase values such as `success` are rejected with a 400.

errorInfo.description: Gateway error details for the GSM-based scoring filter. When present and the merchant flag is on, user/issuer-originated failures are skipped so the gateway is not penalised.

isSmartRetry.description: Set by the orchestrator when this call is a smart-retry attempt.

gsm_info.description: GSM lookup result. Present only when `errorInfo` was supplied and a matching rule was found.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the rule.

data.description: Depends on type: array of ConnectorInfo ({gateway_name, gateway_id}) for `priority`; single ConnectorInfo for `single`; array of {split, output} for `volume_split`; Euclid AST Program for `advanced`; ABTestData ({control_algorithm_id, variant_algorithm_id, variant_split_pct, min_sample_size, guardrail_threshold_pp, variant_sr_config?, control_sr_config?}) for `ab_test`

config.description: Tagged config variant. `type` is `successRate`, `elimination`, or `debitRouting`. `data` holds the variant-specific fields.

MultiObjectiveInfo.description: Present when the multi-objective (cost-aware) post-step ran. Explains why the gateway was picked: the SR head was kept (AUTH_WON) or a higher economic-value PSP was promoted (COST_WON). Economic value is auth rate × settlement value, where settlement value = txn amount − cost of payment processing (acquirer, issuer & network fee).

reason.example: Promoted 'adyen' over 'stripe' on expected value — saves 80.00 bps for 3.00pp auth.

srHead.description: The PSP the SR scorer would have picked.

chosen.description: The PSP the post-step actually chose. Equals srHead when auth won.

costSavedBps.description: Fee saved in bps when outcome is COST_WON (srHead.costBps - chosen.costBps).

qualifiedCount.description: Number of PSPs that had cost data and were ranked on expected value.

margin.description: Merchant margin (fraction of ticket) applied for this transaction. Configured via the successRate config margin field; defaults to 1.0.

evGapTop2.description: Expected-value gap between the top-two EV-ranked PSPs, as a fraction of ticket. Null when fewer than two PSPs had cost data.

key.description: Opaque cluster key, used in the override PUT/DELETE path.

n.description: Transaction count. 0 for an override-only cluster no longer in the top set.

effective_pct_bps.description: Null when the cluster has no usable rate at all.

verdict.description: `GOOD`, `THIN`, `NON_LINEAR`, or `""` for an override-only cluster. A non-GOOD rate is shown so it can be corrected - it is not what the router trusts.

card_product.description: Issuer BIN's dominant interchange rate as integer bps (`"115"`), or `""` when the report carried no PAN.

segments.description: Recovered per-segment rates for a capped/tiered cluster. Empty for an ordinary GOOD cluster.

ClusterOverride.description: Cluster dimensions are flattened into this object alongside the override values.

tiered_clusters.description: One line can't price it, but its recovered amount tiers can.

good_txn_pct.description: Share of transactions with a trustworthy single-line model.

priced_txn_pct.description: Share of transactions the router can price: GOOD plus TIERED.

priced_gross_pct.description: Share of settled volume the router can price. The real coverage headline.

AddonDto.description: A connector's stored invoice add-on. The add-on fields are flattened alongside `connector`.

fields.description: Success-rate routing dimensions. Must be from the eligible set.

ValueType.description: Euclid condition value. Tagged by `type`; `value` holds the payload.

value.description: Shape depends on `type`: number->integer, enum_variant/str_value/global_ref->string, number_array/enum_variant_array->array of number/string, number_comparison_array->array of comparisons.

RoutingRequest.description: Request body for POST /routing/evaluate (src/euclid/types.rs::RoutingRequest). No camelCase rename — snake_case field names.

fallback_output.description: Used when the rule evaluation yields no eligible connector.

parameters.description: Map of DSL parameter name (e.g. currency, amount, cardType) to its ValueType.

orderReference.description: Full internal order object. `merchantId` inside it identifies the merchant. `udfs` is an ARRAY of strings, not an object, and `id` is an integer.

orderMetadata.description: Full internal order-metadata object. Required. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

txnDetail.description: Full internal transaction object. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

txnCardInfo.description: Full internal card/payment-method object. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

merchantAccount.description: Full internal merchant account object. `gatewaySuccessRateBasedDeciderInput` is a required string - `null` is rejected.

LegacyDeciderRequest.description: Legacy decider payload built from full internal transaction objects. This is NOT the `/decide-gateway` shape - posting that body here is rejected with a 400. `orderMetadata`, `txnDetail` and `txnCardInfo` must each carry a `partitionKey` key (value may be null).

id.description: Numeric string. Must be present and parse as an integer - the conversion unwraps the parsed value, so a missing or non-numeric id panics the handler instead of returning a 4xx.

txn_detail.description: Full internal transaction object. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

txn_card_info.description: Full internal card/payment-method object. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

LegacyUpdateScoreRequest.description: Legacy score-feedback payload built from full internal transaction objects. This is NOT the `/update-gateway-score` shape. `txn_detail` and `txn_card_info` must each carry a `partitionKey` key (value may be null), and their `id` fields are numeric strings.

algorithm_data.description: The stored algorithm, tagged by `type` with the variant payload under `data`.

JsonifiedRoutingAlgorithm.description: Full routing algorithm record as returned by the list endpoints.

keys.description: Map of routing-key name to its metadata.

HybridRoutingRequest.description: At least one of `static_routing_request` or `dynamic_routing_request` must be provided.

static_routing.description: Result of the static rule evaluation.

dynamic_routing.description: Decision-gateway result, wrapped as `{status, decision, fallback_connectors}`.

evaluated_connectors.description: Connectors clients should consume. Prefer this over the per-branch outputs.

merchant_reference_id.description: Your own reference, echoed in the response.

payment_type.description: The `payment_type` rule key: `normal`, `new_mandate`, `update_mandate`, `setup_mandate`, `recurring_mandate`, `non_mandate` or `ppt_mandate`. A rule that tests `payment_type` matches only when it is sent.

merchant_connector_id.description: The connector account. Omit to name the connector by name alone.

decision_arm.description: Caller-assigned decision arm, retained in the request audit. Does not override Decision Engine's internal experiment assignment. Omit or send null when unspecified.

id.description: Unique per decision (`dec_` + a time-ordered UUID), so a retried payment's decisions stay apart.

connectors.description: The order to try connectors in: the first is the choice, the rest the retry order. Empty when no connector is left.

rule.description: The rule layer's result. Null when it failed, and a `warnings` entry then says why.

success_rate.description: Null when success-rate routing did not run (the `sr-routing` setting is off, or the A/B arm has no SR layer).

cost.description: Null when the cost step did not run.

volume_steering.description: Null when no volume commitment was considered.

warnings.description: Problems the decision routed around. Routing problems never fail the call.

DecideOutcome.description: How the order was reached. New values may be added to each enum, so treat an unknown value as its nearest documented meaning.

strategy.description: The layer that set the final order.

message.description: For people reading logs. Not stable, so branch on `reason`.

output.description: The algorithm's output by `type` (`straight_through`, `priority`, `volume_split`, `volume_split_priority`), laid out as in `RoutingEvaluateResponse.output` with connectors in the `DecideResultConnector` shape.

selected.description: The connectors the rule layer chose, narrowed to the eligible ones.

eligible.description: The connectors the payment method can use.

diagnostics.description: The decider's internals, for support: `head_before_downtime_check`, `reset_approach`, `dimension {value, level}`, `filter_wise_connectors`, `priority_logic {tag, output}`, `dynamic_mga_enabled`, `connector_mga_id_map`, `rust_based_decider` and `latency_ms`. Not covered by compatibility guarantees.

status.description: `cost_won`: a cheaper connector won. `auth_won`: the success-rate head kept it.

ranked.description: Every connector ranked on expected value, best first.

status.description: `steered`: a connector behind on its commitment took it. `sr_prevailed`: normal routing kept it.

reason.description: Why this commitment did not get the payment.

param.description: The request field the warning is about, such as `card.card_network`, when there is one.

merchant_connector_id.description: Null for a connector named without an account.

lo.description: Inclusive lower bound of the amount range this piece prices.

RoutingDictionaryRecord.description: Summary record returned when a routing rule is created.

DeciderErrorResponse.description: Error envelope returned by the gateway-decision routes.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Generic API error envelope: an error code, a human-readable message, and an optional structured payload.
